detail.longDescription: Employees with autism report hidden labor of workplace camouflaging in new study https:// phys.org/news/2026-10-employee s-autism-hidden-labor-workplace.html > Employees with autism may expend considerable time and effort modifying their behavior to meet workplace expectations, from rehearsing conversations and monitoring facial expressions to concealing sensory discomfort, according to a new study led by a Penn State researcher. # autism # masking # work # stress # research
